marks.conclusion: A small classifier or decision head over a 10x10x5 board with an 8x8 interior; it reduces the board to one or two scores and gives a 3-way decision; the channels' meanings and the task are left undetermined.
marks.judge_notes: No border credit: the reply calls the border inputs constant 0 and untrained, not always-on. Layout 1 of 2: it gives where ch0 (column 1 only), ch1 (columns 2-8) and ch4 (columns 1-8) carry weight but assigns no meaning, and it treats ch2 and ch3 as unused. Actions 0: the up/down/left/right reading is offered as one of two variants and called speculative, so it is a guess. Depth level 2: it follows hidden units 15, 141, 3, 16 and 27 through to outputs 1 and 2 and correctly finds that outputs 0, 3 and 4 are interchangeable and only 1 and 2 carry signal; there is no mechanism. ReLU is argued from the paired-unit pattern, but ReLU is wrong (tanh), so activation gets 0. It writes 'softmax cross-entropy' / 'classifier' and also mentions RL; it never identifies RL training from evidence. I did not deduct for 'classifier' or for the hedged ReLU inference. I could not check the weights themselves because they are not in the folder, so depth is judged for internal consistency and against the fact sheet only.
